text: #695, step 9 of #564's plan, recorded at its merge. A configured repository's trusted changes are held for a person. Trust is derived from the captured base contract, never from a draft's displayed Trusted metadata, and always covers CI, the repository contract, agent instruction and tool files, and declared rules, dependencies, lockfiles and additional trusted paths. Scope classifies every actual changed path, deletions included, and the base policy is read again before marking ready or merging. Held drafts stay drafts for a person, and GitHub refusing a workflow change hands off instead of pushing again. The merger made three additions after the build's review. Agent files are AGENTS.md, Codex's AGENTS.override.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .mcp.json, .codex/ and .claude/, matched whatever their case, because a case-insensitive file system serves a variant spelling to an agent. A held draft that a crash left open gets its handoff description through a new, lease-checked DescribePullRequest. No other recovered pull request's description is touched. Symlinked agent files (#705) and a published branch that moved before publication (#706) are open follow-ups. The second fails closed meanwhile.
